newsitem.title: USA: UPS plans $59 million plant at Memphis airport.
newsitem.headline: UPS plans $59 million plant at Memphis airport.

text.p: United Parcel Service said Monday it will sign a lease with the Memphis/Shelby County Airport Authority next week to build a $59 million package-sorting facility at the Memphis International Airport.
The plant will be built on an 84-acre site. Scheduled to open in November 1998, the 535,000-square-foot hub will process more than 250,000 packages and documents a day.
When the plant is in full operation, UPS will employ more than 2,000 people in the Memphis area, up from about 1,400 currently, it said.
